Hi Liam —

Hope you had a great weekend. I'm Kimberly on the Customer Marketing team at Redwood. We're putting together a short customer profile highlighting how teams are using Redwood Dedicated, and we'd love to feature HelixHealth given the throughput wins you mentioned back in May.

Would you and a product/ops stakeholder be open to a 30-minute on-camera conversation the week of June 10? High-level goals:
- Capture the business problem you were solving with Redwood Dedicated
- Walk through a short before/after on latency and cost impact
- Talk about how you measure success (dashboards/metrics)

If helpful, we can send a simple release form and a short agenda in advance. Proposed slots:
- Thu 6/10 09:30–10:00 PT
- Thu 6/10 13:00–13:30 PT
- Fri 6/11 10:00–10:30 PT

Any of those work? If not, ping a time that does and we'll follow up with a calendar invite.

Thanks — and we'll keep it lightweight.

Best,

Hi Liam & Priya —

Great — thanks for confirming Thu 6/10 at 09:30 PT. I'll send a calendar invite momentarily. Quick answers to your questions and what we'll need from you ahead of the call:

1) Interview metrics/questions (short list) — we'll ask about:
   - Primary latency and tail-latency baseline vs current (p95/p99 where available)
   - Token/unit cost improvements after Dedicated + batching/quantization changes
   - Throughput/requests-per-second changes and any notable scaling behavior
   - Any operational benefits: reliability, failover, or fewer incidents
   - A short customer quote on business impact (one or two sentences)

2) Recording & rights — we will record the interview for internal note-taking and to produce a short written case profile. We request non-exclusive rights to: quote your team in a written profile and include one short screenshot of aggregated metrics (no PII). We do not publish any raw logs or customer data.

   - If you prefer, we can share the draft profile for approval before publishing (we usually do this).

3) Documents attached — I'm including our simple release form and a tentative agenda for the call. If legal needs changes, please mark them and we can iterate.

What we'll pull together on our side for the call:
- 10–12 minute conversation schedule: 3 min intros, 8–10 min product/metrics discussion, 7–8 min outcomes/quote + next steps
- A short list of follow-up items (screenshots, opt-in for quote approval, publication timeline)

If that's all good, I'll send the invite for Thu 6/10 09:30 PT and include the release form. Looking forward to it.

Best,
Kimberly
